data: What is the approximate value of the red dashed line on the y-axis?

The red dashed line represents the approximate error value for both Recurrent GAN and seqGAN as a function of the number of generator runs (N). The caption specifies that the value of α is 10 and γ′ is 10^-3. The y-axis is labeled as "Error (infinite norm)" and ranges from 10^-2 to 10^-3. The red dashed line appears to be at approximately 10^-3 on the y-axis. Therefore, the approximate value of the red dashed line on the y-axis is 10^-3.
